icp.name: Founder/Operator
icp.description: A solo founder or small team running a SaaS, creator business, or freelance venture who needs social proof to convert visitors but lacks engineering resources for custom solutions.

problems: Difficulty collecting video testimonials at scale
Lack of a centralized repository for social proof assets
Complex embedding processes for website testimonials
Inability to repurpose raw feedback into marketing assets

competitors.name: Testimonial.to
competitors.positioning: A minimal widget for collecting and displaying text and video testimonials, focused on simplicity for small teams.

competitors.name: VideoTestimonial.io
competitors.positioning: Specialized in recording and editing video testimonials with a focus on high-production quality for enterprise brands.

competitors.name: Trustpilot
competitors.positioning: A large-scale review platform focused on aggregated consumer reviews and brand reputation management.
